## About

PyVSP Deep Learning Lookahead is the reproducibility pipeline for temporal-convolutional-network inversion of vertical seismic profiling data [@almarzooq2026vsp]. It covers synthetic model generation, hyperparameter optimization, training, ablation studies, blind tests, field inference, robustness analysis, and publication figures and tables.

## Why it matters

Estimating velocity ahead of the drill bit can reduce subsurface uncertainty before a formation is reached. The project evaluates data-driven lookahead inversion on deterministic finite-difference simulations and Volve field data, while retaining conventional baselines.

## Key result and audience

The repository turns the full manuscript workflow into a configurable pipeline and includes repeatability, bandwidth, and phase-sensitivity experiments. It is aimed at VSP researchers, seismic inversion practitioners, and teams reviewing reproducible machine-learning studies.
